title: Loss-Aversively Fair Classification
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The fairness benchmarks are focused on sensitive attributes like gender and race.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on a notion of 'loss-averse' fairness when updating decision-making systems, using race and gender as examples of sensitive attributes.
